description: This Java class is a Spring Boot EnvironmentPostProcessor that processes environment variables related to PostgreSQL database URLs. It maps environment variables like DATABASE_URL into Spring Boot's datasource configuration, normalizing various URL formats and handling SSL mode settings.

classes.name: DatabaseUrlEnvironmentPostProcessor
classes.description: A Spring Boot environment post-processor that maps database URL environment variables to Spring datasource properties and normalizes various URL formats into JDBC URLs with SSL mode configured.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order value for this post-processor to determine processing precedence.

methods.name: postProcessEnvironment
methods.description: Main method that reads environment variables, normalizes database URLs, parses them, and injects the resulting datasource properties into the Spring environment.

methods.name: firstNonBlank
methods.description: Returns the first non-blank string from the provided arguments.

methods.name: normalizeDatabaseUrl
methods.description: Removes leading 'psql' commands, flags, and quotes from database URL strings to normalize them for parsing.

methods.name: parseToJdbc
methods.description: Parses the normalized database URL into a JDBC URL and credentials, ensuring sslmode=require.

methods.name: ensureSslMode
methods.description: Ensures that the JDBC URL includes 'sslmode=require' query parameter.

methods.name: parseQuery
methods.description: Parses URL query parameters into a Map.

methods.name: urlEncode
methods.description: Encodes strings for URL query parameters.
